hero.description: I'm a fullstack engineer centered on Vue 3 and Laravel. I take work from discovery through production — DDD-style boundaries, Postgres or MySQL, Redis, and Docker-first deploys on Coolify or a VPS. When it fits the problem, I bridge web and hardware (IoT, Raspberry Pi, privacy-aware integrations); Eu no Play is one example. I work like a technical co-founder: product judgment, solid engineering, and ownership past the launch line.
hero.ctaProjectsAria: Jump to the featured project section

about.bio: I like turning ideas into live product. I grew up on the frontend, doubled down on Vue, and expanded into resilient APIs and Laravel with an architecture-first mindset. Sometimes the right solution sits between a browser and a device in the field — I'm comfortable there too. I care about scope, quality, and deployment as one narrative. I'm looking for international remote teams where clarity and ownership matter.

timeline.title: Early work with Vue 2
timeline.description: Cut my teeth on the web with Vue 2 and a classic frontend stack — where I learned to care about clear UI, solid UX, and maintainable CSS.

timeline.title: Leveling up on Vue 3 & Nuxt 3
timeline.description: Composition API, TypeScript, and Nuxt 3 on real deliveries — a step change in how I structure apps, collaborate, and ship with confidence.

timeline.title: Backend depth with Laravel
timeline.description: Hardened APIs, business logic where it belongs, and end-to-end thinking — from interface to persistence, queues, and day-two operations.

timeline.title: Production SaaS & IoT
timeline.description: From concept to live systems: billing, auth, scale — plus builds that pair software with hardware (Raspberry Pi, on-venue testing). Product focus with an eye on global remote work.

stack.title: How I build
stack.subtitle: The toolkit behind my fullstack deliveries — Vue and Nuxt on the surface, Laravel and data stores underneath, and infra I can run and iterate on myself.
